notes.title: Jackal Demo will be fully compatible with Steam Deck on launch
notes.content:
[p]I made extra effort for Jackal to be 100% compatible with Steam Deck on launch, this includes:

* Twin-stick shooter controls
* All content can be accessed with the controller
* Shows Steam Deck glyphs for controls/tutorials
* All interface is legible on the small screen

Demo release date soon to be announced.
MM[/p]
